"'''Warlock'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was present on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]], where she [[Instructor/Legends|instructed]] other [[Imperial Agent]]s.
